(Men's) }}}} '''Athlitiki Enosi Lemesou''' ({{langx|el|'''Α'''θλητική '''Έ'''νωση '''Λ'''εμεσού|translation=Athletic Union of Limassol}}) is a [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] [[sports club]] based in the city of [[Limassol]], [[Cyprus]], best known for its football team. AEL Limassol also maintains a [[AEL Limassol B.C.|men's]] and [[AEL Limassol B.C. (women)|women's]] basketball teams, a women's volleyball team and a (newly established in 1976) Futsal team, a women's handball team as well as a cricket team.
